summary: Added src/slug.js (slugify: replace /[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g with '-', trim edge hyphens, then lowercase) and test/slug.test.js covering A1/A2 plus non-ASCII, digits, mixed runs, and empty-result (D1). The slug lane passes (4 tests).
notes: Lowercasing happens after classification so U+212A and U+0130 stay separators; no /i flag.
